ai_summary: Amanta Healthcare reported modest 5% Q1 FY27 revenue growth to INR 69 crores, maintaining a healthy 22% EBITDA margin despite inflationary pressures and initial costs absorbed from upcoming facilities. The critical SteriPort Line 3, though slightly delayed to late Q2 FY27, is now FDA approved and scheduled for late August commercialization, poised to add INR 110-120 crores in annual revenue and drive a 4-5% consolidated EBITDA margin expansion, further supported by INR 9 crores in annual savings from its newly commissioned captive solar plant.
